scope: Every unique reference 5000 <= reference < 6000 in the recovered-M328 line ledger; object types independently read from Texts metadata column5.
protocol: Manual visual reading of the complete first metadata line for each selected reference. Six code digits following four reference digits are recorded literally; object type is the fifth digit overall. No candidate-export codes or numeric-range type inference used.

layout.section: 12.2: ten digits; type column5, side6, field7–8, line9, direction10

limitations: Object type is Mahadevan catalogue classification, not independent physical-object or material verification.
Code3 groups stone, terracotta and faience; it is not a material or manufacture code.
First-line side/line is not necessarily the M328-bearing line; only object type transfers across sides.
Direction is line-specific; no object-wide direction assignment made.
No functional meaning of M328 is established solely by object category.
